inclusion_rule: Surface-EMG speech synthesis or voicing studies (EMG to audible speech), classified by the intermediate target the EMG model predicts before the waveform: spectral acoustic features (mel, MFCC, vocoder parameters), self-supervised speech units, articulatory features (EMA-type trajectories), or text/phonemes. Boundary: EMG recognition to text only, EMG as an auxiliary channel to audio, non-speech EMG and reviews are excluded when read; a study can use several targets; versions count once.
